Hi Alicia 

Thanks for the questionnaire  we'll start populating that and can return a draft within 48 hours. To answer your direct questions:

Pen test report: we completed a third-party penetration test in Q2 2026. We can provide a redacted/summary version of the full report (redwood-pen-test-report-stub.pdf) to external customers under an NDA. The redaction removes customer-specific payloads and PII; platform-level findings are included.

Vulnerability management SLA and cadence (high-level):
- Critical (CVSS 9-10 / remote RCE with data exposure): acknowledge within 4 hours, mitigation plan within 24 hours, patch or emergency mitigation within 72 hours.
- High (CVSS 7-8.9): acknowledge within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours.
- Medium/Low: triaged and scheduled according to risk and release windows; weekly authenticated scans inform prioritization.

Scanning and testing cadence:
- Weekly internal authenticated scans (credentialed) and daily vulnerability scanning for infra layer.
- Quarterly external penetration tests by a CREST/OSCP vendor; ad-hoc tests for major releases or high-risk integrations.

Coordinated disclosure: Redwood follows a coordinated disclosure policy. If an external researcher reports an issue we validate and work with the reporter; for customer-reported issues we coordinate timelines and provide timely updates. We're happy to align on a disclosure cadence with FinHealth  typically security teams agree on a 30-day remediation window for high-severity issues before public disclosure, unless disclosure is required by law/regulation.

HIPAA: Redwood does not ingest PHI by default. For customers requiring HIPAA controls, we offer a private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) and contractual BAAs. For the planned integration where you only pass hashed identifiers, that would typically not constitute PHI, but we can review specifics with legal if needed.

Next steps I propose:
1) We return the completed vendor questionnaire (draft) by Tue EOD 10/20.
2) Scheduled intake call Tue 10/20 10:00-10:30 PT to confirm pen test sharing mechanism and NDA scope.
3) If NDA needed, we'll originate a short mutual NDA via DocuSign and attach the redacted report once executed.

I've attached a pen test summary stub for your review. Happy to go deeper on the intake call  Marcus can cover architecture details.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-pen-test-report-stub.pdf
